verdict.rationale: Snowflake exposes strong programmatic surfaces — a SQL REST API, a general resource-management REST API, an official CLI (verified runtime-executable), OpenAPI specs, and even an MCP server for agents — which together cover most administrative and query workloads an AI-native user would need. However, there's no explicit documentation claiming full UI/API parity, and several UI-centric experiences (Snowsight Notebooks, Cortex Analyst's natural-language UI, cost-anomaly dashboards) aren't shown to have equivalent API-driven paths in this evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, API equivalents for Notebooks/Cortex Analyst UI flows, and independent confirmation that all Snowsight actions are API-accessible.
